status: PROPOSAL ONLY; NOT SELECTED, RUN OR AUTHORIZED BY THIS FILE
question: Can the answer-first current local reader answer fresh real development questions better with their report than without it?

positive_control_reference.meaning: Harnesstrivial-function check only, not financial-reading skill.

sample.rule: After a separate run decision, Random(seed).sample(sorted(all unique pinned TAT-QA devUIDs minus these70),30); no answer/type/success filter or resampling. Fresh questions do not imply fresh reports; count/report context overlap.

source.data_license: CC BY4.0; code MIT; same immutable pre-2022 qualified dev asset
source.native_scorer: Unmodified TaTQAEmAndF1 from the same pin; no PC1 normalizer or scalar-only scoring rule applied to benchmark answers.

harness.prompt_and_schema: Exact answer-first prompt/schema/strict ReaderAnswer parse from PC1, think=false; no retuning on the70exposed questions.
harness.input: Only question/table/paragraph fields; no answer,type,derivation or evidence labels. Both predictions finish before native gold scoring.
harness.limitations: PC1 validates scalar tasks only. Its prompt is scalar-oriented although its schema/native scorer allow lists; multi-span weakness remains unvalidated and must not be hidden with a type filter. A changed prompt needs a new recorded contract, not an assumed PC1 qualification.

metrics.accounting: All30perarm, including abstentions/errors/unattempted as misses, with separate attempted counts and completed-pair denominators. Publish allitems; incomplete run is not completed efficacy.
metrics.secondary: Coverage, invalid JSON, unit errors, location/normalized-quote validity, latency and resource usage. Citation existence is not support proof.
metrics.inference: Descriptive small-sample intervals only, no claim of model superiority/general skill/formal H1 or historical usability; no-report abstention is not a clean training-contamination test.

proposed_limits.runtime_deviation_from_PC1: Larger context8192->16384 to retain complete real inputs; this is proposed, not tested here. Freeze it explicitly and verify a conservative serialized-input bound; oversized inputs fail visibly, never truncate/resample.
proposed_limits.cost_note: Ceilings, not a latency forecast. Tiny synthetic latency does not establish real-report cost.

stops: No retries, replacement or tuning. Stop on transport/model-pin/resource failure; keep all failures and unattempted cases. Freeze exact30UIDs, input/scorer/model/source hashes, order and limits in a commit before generation.
readiness: Requires a new bounded run decision, input-adapter rehearsal and final resource/context contract. No benchmark corpus was opened, no30items drawn and no model request made for this proposal.
non_claims: No model acquisition, training, financial returns, prices, source-clock clearance or sealed data.
